q.line: Where half the clientele was part poltergeist
stanza: You took your love to the marketplace
In the wanton corner of a Western state
Where every other shopper is a basket case
Just realizing the horizon forms a frowning face
Hanging around those haunts at night
Where half the clientele was part poltergeist
Grinding an axe against all that exists
Minus their protected exceptions to it

partner.line: Hanging around those haunts at night

stanza: Like I was no good (You lied)
Like I couldn't do it for you (You lied)
And it's all because you lied
Loved you more than ever (You lied)
More than my own life (You lied)
But that part of me I gave you (You lied)
And it's all because you lied

partner.line: But that part of me I gave you (You lied)
